0: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a Human Soldier creature with power and toughness each equal to the number of loyalty counters on him and gains indestructible. He's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.

blocked_sentences: 0: Until end of turn, Gideon becomes a Human Soldier creature with power and toughness each equal to the number of loyalty counters on him and gains indestructible. He's still a planeswalker. Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.

needs.what: A one-shot prevention effect scoped to a permanent (here the source itself) with a 'this turn' duration: 'Prevent all damage that would be dealt to him this turn.' -- e.g. `prevent_damage` taking `objects` beside `player`, installing a per-object DamageShield cleared at cleanup
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `prevent_damage` op takes only `player` and `duration` and shields a seat, never a permanent. The `prevent_damage` static with `prevent_all` can shield a permanent but is continuous with no 'this turn' clock, so as a printed static on Gideon it would protect him on every turn. The `grant_ability` op cannot hand over a static (granted statics are never read by `_battlefield_statics`). `grant_protection` from_everything would also stop targeting/blocking/attachment, a different card.
